newsitem.title: HUNGARY: No trade on Hungary BCE meat section for the day.
newsitem.headline: No trade on Hungary BCE meat section for the day.

text.p: The Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) grain section did not open its meat section on Thursday as the number of brokers present had not reached the required minimum of three, the BCE said on Thursday.
Consequently, settlement prices remain those of December 19, the last previous day of trade.
The currency and grain sections are trading normally.
The Budapest Commodity Exchange has a currency futures, a grains and a meat section, of which the meat section is the smallest, with a 600 million forints turnover last year.
The meat section trades on Tuesdays and Thursdays. --Budapest newsroom +36 1 327 4040
